summary: AC Immune SA furnished a Form 6-K with a press release covering Q1 2026 financial and corporate updates. The filing reports cash and short-term financial assets totaling CHF 74.8 million as of March 31, 2026, and provides an operational update on clinical trials and collaborations with Takeda and Eli Lilly, including a $12 million milestone payment and an amended Morphomer Tau agreement. This is a routine periodic financial update with no strategic corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or delisting. The disclosure is standard for a foreign private issuer.
